      "snippet": "Here’s exactly what to do — step-by-step, no guessing:

🧰 1. Open Termux
Just launch the Termux app on your phone.

📁 2. Give it storage access (only once)
bashCopy codetermux-setup-storage

Tap “Allow access to files.”

Wait until it finishes (you’ll see a new storage folder under /data/data/com.termux/files/home).

📦 3. Create the crawler folder and output folder
Copy-paste:
bashCopy codemkdir -p ~/tools/crawler ~/storage/downloads/MB_Ingest_Out
